departures_from_the_finale_doc: Codex's doc has no battles and no teams: its Brann stands down ('My people will not fight a trainer who came through eight leaders to stop that') and its Elara opens the shaft after a conversation. The owner asked for a confrontation with both as trainers, so both fight. Brann's line 4 is dropped and his stand-down is moved to after the battle; Elara's lines 1-4 open her battle and 5-7 close it.

Codex places Brann in hq_briefing_hall and Elara in hq_director_office (data/deep_city.json hq). The HQ interior is another builder's unit (2026-10-04); the owner's handover (docs/HANDOVER_SESSION.md item 6) puts 'the cradle chamber with Elara and Brann and the release' together, so they stand in the cradle. If the HQ builder seats them in their rooms instead, these two seats move and nothing else does.

Codex's intermediate stages (deep_handoff_received, hq_crossed, anchor_shutdown, cradle_open) are NOT added: the HQ builder coordinates on the stage enum in data/progression.json, and the confrontation's state is two per-player booleans instead, read beside stage == rift_crisis_pending.

dialogue_text.pre: Nia sent you. Every person below us has watched a home fail, and I will not call them villains for wanting one place that stays. Show me you can stop this without killing the city.
dialogue_text.player_win: I read Tomas's result. The destination is occupied, and Elara ordered the cycle anyway. I am standing the cradle guard down. Do not mistake that for forgiveness.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Go back up. A reckless shutdown kills this city, and you are not ready to make a careful one.

dialogue_text.pre: Listen to the city before you call this simple. I knew the destination was occupied. I ordered the cycle because I could name the people who would die if I stopped.
dialogue_text.player_win: That certainty became an excuse to leave the other names blank. There is no operation left to finish. Release it, and we begin the work that cannot be solved by exchanging somebody else's home.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Every light below us belongs to someone the Compact carried out. Do not come back to put them out.

trainers.after_win: Elara steps back from her console. The binder at the restraint is waiting for you.
